scope: Independent own programs on unchanged NXP software model,OMR300;software ISA/timing evidence,not silicon or complete instrument acceptance.
admitted_forms: Parallel raw A1/B1 -> X0/X1/Y0/Y1/R0..7 accompanying TFR Y0,A/B or ADD B,A/A,B. The raw move uses the old middle word without full-accumulator scaling/limiting. ALU results use old operands and retain their independent status effects.
interlock_rule: Only a preceding one-word writer to the raw bus source accumulator adds a period. Other accumulator ALU inputs retain ordinary forwarding.
reference_cases: All12 destinations and two raw sources/four ALU forms;carry/overflow/zero/normalization,prior sticky flags,scaling,48 own/foreign partial writers with0/1/2 gaps,and two consecutive loader-shaped old-value captures.

assembler_diagnostics.resolution: Original diagnostics and failed qualifier retained. One isolated clean assembler-only pass per affected input produced identical complete words/starts;no CPU replay. Wine root cause remains unknown.

automatic_scope: 180 own native reset-preamble/RAM streams;3710 complete per-period CPU/table-counter/all16-stack checks. Exact E1 raw destinations and E2 ALU/status/PC.532 cuts across24 selected cases restore twice per sanitizer profile;736 unsupported forms retain strict Decode context. SZ is initialized by actual own MOVEC;explicit own NOP memory supplies bounded prefetch.
limits: Other ALU/raw forms,arithmetic/memory producers,SR-read timing,original near-end calls,IRQ/cache/extended stack,authentic ROM/reserved memory,full original reset-to-instrument and complete MIDI/audio/storage/update/recovery/realtime acceptance remain unqualified.
